title: Python: plain Dodag.process_dio performs no SCHC rule-version admission check
description: spec/03-adaptation.md 5.7: 'A node MUST NOT join a DODAG when the option is absent, malformed, reserved, unsupported, or differs from its local immutable registry.' Classification: divergent on a public API path. Evidence: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py:376-459 plain process_dio has no rule-version check; production node.py uses only the authenticated path (dodag.py:501-508 -> link/link_layer.py:898-938 which enforces exactly-one option + v3 + allows_dodag_join). Rust plain process_dio is #[cfg(test)] (rust/lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs:329-340) so not exposed. Risk: library consumers calling the plain API bypass DODAG admission. Suggested placement: add the version gate to the plain path or restrict/mark the API. Filed from spec-coverage sweep 2026-08-31 (R-03-053).
